name: ThimPress AI Chatbot with Chatboz
author: ThimPress

sections.description:
Tired of answering the exact same questions day in and day out? Your customers want instant answers before buying, and your students need immediate help when they get stuck. But let’s face it: most websites still rely on clunky contact forms and slow email threads.

Enter ThimPress AI Chatbot with Chatboz. We bring a true 24/7 virtual assistant right to your WordPress website. The best part? This AI automatically “reads” and learns from your existing website content to support your visitors in a completely natural way.

Instead of losing impatient customers who can’t find what they need, Chatboz keeps them engaged with instant, accurate answers.

Useful Links

  • Live Demo: Chatboz Demo
  • Documentation: View Docs
  • Terms of Use: View Terms
  • Privacy Policy: View Policy

Is Your Website Losing Customers?

Internet users have zero patience these days. If you own a website, you probably know these headaches all too well:

  • Visitors bounce because they can’t be bothered to dig through dozens of pages for one piece of info.
  • Your support team wastes hours typing out the exact same replies.
  • Shoppers abandon their WooCommerce carts just because a minor question went unanswered.
  • You have amazing articles and docs, but nobody actually reads them.

You already have the answers on your site. The trick is delivering them to the right person, at the exact moment they need it.

How Chatboz Saves the Day

Picture this: It is midnight, and your support team is fast asleep. A visitor lands on your site, wondering which course is right for them or what specific features a product has. Instead of leaving for a competitor, they just type their question into the chat widget.

Instantly, Chatboz steps in with a friendly, human-like response based precisely on the content you’ve already written on your site.

For WooCommerce stores, it acts like a highly knowledgeable sales rep. For LearnPress sites, it is a dedicated teaching assistant. Everything runs smoothly, your customers are happy, and you save countless hours.

Standout Features

  • Natural Conversations: No more robotic, rigid scripts. Users ask questions in their own words, and the AI understands and replies fluidly.
  • Auto-Learns from Your Website: The Data Synchronization feature allows the AI to ingest and learn from your existing posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.
  • WooCommerce Sales Booster: The chatbot understands your product details, helping it provide accurate advice that gives customers the confidence to hit Buy.
  • Deep LearnPress Support: Give your online course website a smarter assistant that can help students find answers faster.
  • Full Control: Easily turn the frontend chat widget on or off with a single click in the settings panel.

Quick and Easy Setup

No need to spoon-feed questions and answers to the bot. Just follow these steps:

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Ai Chatboz > Get Started in your dashboard.
  3. Connect your Chatboz account.
  4. Pick the posts and products you want the AI to learn from using Data Synchronization and hit sync.
  5. Enable the chat widget, and you’re done. Your AI is ready to greet visitors.

Who Is This Plugin For?

If you want to provide top-tier customer care without expanding your support team, this plugin is for you. It is absolutely perfect for:

  • WooCommerce stores looking for automated, 24/7 product consulting.
  • Online course creators using LearnPress who need an assistant to answer student queries instantly.
  • Businesses and blogs with a massive amount of content that need a smart tool to help users find information effortlessly.

Requirements

  • WordPress.
  • PHP 7.4 or higher.
  • A registered Chatboz account.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/thim-ai-chatbot-with-chatboz directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Create a Chatboz account at https://chatboz.com/ if you do not already have one.
  4. Navigate to Ai Chatboz > Get Started in the left sidebar.
  5. Connect your Chatboz account.
  6. Set up your data synchronization and enjoy.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Chatboz account?

Yes, you do. This plugin acts as the bridge between your WordPress site and the Chatboz AI brain. Head over to Chatboz.com to learn more and create your account.

Does the AI know WooCommerce prices and stock status?

Absolutely. When you sync your product data, the AI absorbs details like price, SKU, stock status, categories, and tags to give your customers highly accurate advice.

Does the plugin support LearnPress?

Yes. Chatboz is designed to work well with LearnPress websites, making it useful for online course creators who want students to get answers faster.

Can I hide the chat widget if I don’t want to use it temporarily?

Of course. You can easily toggle the frontend chat widget on or off at any time right from the plugin settings.
